name: Portal
description: Copy files between workplaces via the coordinator portal bridge.

function.name: portal
function.description:
File bridge across workplaces. Stage under /_portal/<name>/... on the Tomo host, or copy workplace_id:path ↔ portal / another workplace. Small files copy synchronously; large ones return a transfer id — poll with action=status.

Locations:
- /_portal/<name>/relative/path — coordinator staging
- <workplace_id>:<path> — file on that workplace (local/tunnel/ssh)

Actions: copy, status, list, cancel.

background.description: Force async transfer even for small files.
